items.text: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling opted for deltoid rupture repair surgery; expected back late Nov/early Dec (~10 weeks).
items.why: New info led to surgery decision for complete recovery; Shanahan ~10 weeks.
items.implication: Long-term WR depth hole; Deebo and others absorb snaps/routes/targets immediately.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel primary beneficiary with elevated route/target share and red-zone work.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans for IR.
items.why: Glute soft-tissue; team confirmed no IR currently.
items.implication: Backup QB starts; Seahawks pass game and Price/Holani roles shift under different signal-caller.
items.opportunity: Jadarian Price or Holani could see more volume in potentially conservative or pass-heavy script.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out minimum four games to quicken recovery.
items.why: Surgery performed; IR designation for recovery acceleration.
items.implication: Immediate WR depth loss; Flowers/Bateman/Moore targets rise if Flowers healthy.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman and remaining Ravens WRs see route/target share bump; Flowers if active is primary.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after surgery for torn MCL; Hodge promoted, Stoll to PS.
items.implication: Kittle workload/security rises further; TE depth thin behind him.
items.opportunity: George Kittle pure TE1 lock; any backup TE streaming if Kittle limited.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, did not practice Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday vs Texans.
items.why: Self-reported tightness after practice absence; mental reps emphasized.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice; likely active but snap/efficiency risk if limited.
items.opportunity: If limited or out, Chase/Higgins/Brown upside rises in pass game.

items.text: Vikings RB Jordan Mason has small thumb fracture fixed; placed on short-term IR, expected back quickly; DeeJay Dallas signed.
items.why: Surgery on small fracture; coach O'Connell says quick return.
items.implication: Vikings RB depth thins; Aaron Jones or Dallas handle more if needed, but Jones primary.
items.opportunity: Handcuff value to Dallas or remaining backs elevates short-term.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is top Week 2 waiver target after Stribling injury; 21% target share Week 1 plus red-zone work, more opportunity incoming.
items.why: Stribling long-term out creates clear path; solid W1 efficiency and RZ targets.
items.implication: Must-add in most leagues; flex/WR3 with upside in 49ers offense.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets/carries as CMC complement and primary WR now.

items.text: Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; AJ Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Stribling=Deebo/Robinson; Kamara=Miller; Sampson=Sanders; etc. Deebo/Samuel priority.
items.why: Precise mapping of injured starters to available backups with role expansion.
items.implication: Prioritize these for FAAB; streamers listed for QB/RB/WR/TE.
items.opportunity: Immediate snap/route/target bumps for listed beneficiaries if primary OUT.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance Week 2 or 3 return, but same knee had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year—scary history. DNP Wednesday practice.
items.why: Coach positive on return timeline; Levitan flags prior same-knee trauma risk.
items.implication: Have TE backup ready; if out Mayer rises. Monitor practice fully.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Michael Mayer TE1 streaming/handcuff value; reverse if unexpectedly IN.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities and routes/targets as expected in new role.
items.implication: Elite every-down RB1 with receiving upside; ROS rankings spike.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/carry share locked; goal-line and two-minute likely.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23-6 for 156 yards + 2 rec TDs. Utilization 99 tied Bijan.
items.why: Dominant every-down share + efficiency behind improved OL; historical comps elite.
items.implication: Lock RB1 ROS; trade value soars. Berry/Fantasy Life endorse.

items.text: Jameson Williams had 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played horrific game; process strong, results variance.
items.why: High xFP indicates opportunity/volume was there despite poor conversion.
items.implication: Do not panic sell; rebound candidate with Lions WR role.
items.opportunity: Continued high expected points if target share holds; St. Brown primary but Jamo deep threat.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only 4 specialized offensive snaps Week 1 (jet, screens, decoy); zero routes past LOS. Jags intentions clear via offseason moves (Meyers extension, BTJ interest, etc).
items.why: Extremely limited/specialized role matching offseason signals; not every-down WR.
items.implication: Low fantasy floor until role expands; BTJ/Meyers/Washington primary.
items.opportunity: Brian Thomas Jr. and Parker Washington secure higher route shares.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 vs Miller/Donaldson, routes 24/7/5, opportunities 18/9/4.
items.why: Even without Kamara, shared significant snaps/routes/opportunities.
items.implication: Low-end RB2 until clearer lead; Kamara return further dilutes.
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller handcuff/stash value elevated as committee piece.
